newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV to lift suspension on Santana shares.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV to lift suspension on Santana shares.

text.p: Spain's stock market watchdog the CNMV said on Monday it would lift its suspension on trade in Santana Motor shares from Tuesday after receiving details on its upcoming acquisition.
The CNMV suspended trade in Santana shares, which are not traded electronically but on the open outcry system, on June 5.

Soprea, the Spanish firm which promotes the economic development of the southern region of Andalusia, announced early in June that it would propose buying the remaining 16.26 percent of Santana that it does not already hold.
"The CNMV agrees to lift, with effect from June 24, the suspension of Santana shares as a result of details on the offer being published," the CNMV said in a statement.
